Fig. 1. Atheroprotective effects and mechanisms 
of Emodin. Emodin attenuates atherosclerosis by 
regulating the functions of endothelial cells, 
smooth muscle cells, macrophages and platelets.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Molecular targets of Emodin. Emodin 
modulates atherogenesis by molecular targets such 
as NF-kB, PPAR-gamma, P2X7, p38 and ERK1/2 
pathway. Potential role of Emodin on Nrf2 acti­
vation remains to be investigated.
